subject: V3 Blaze Bluetooth Receiver (A2DP sink) dropouts on official v1.3

device.controller: Broadcom/Cypress BCM43438A1 over UART, AP6212A1 HCD 001.002.009.1010.1030 (HCI/LMP 5.2, build 1030)

source: Android phone (Redmi K70E / Poco F6), LDAC fixed at 990 kb/s unless noted

le_background_scan.trigger: bonded devices stored with LE keys (all three bonded phones/laptop had SupportedTechnologies=BR/EDR;LE)

official_configuration_observed_in_hci.connection_role: BlueZ accepts incoming ACL with role switch to central (AVDTP and AVCTP listeners request master)
official_configuration_observed_in_hci.wifi: wlan0 down; SDIO interrupt count static during tests

change.verified_effect: HCI Read LE Host Support returns LE Supported Host = 0; no LE scan commands while streaming

method.test_application: configuration bind-mounted over the official file in RAM, bluetoothd and bt-agent restarted, Receiver mode entered; reboot between runs
method.capture: btmon HCI capture on the Blaze written to microSD; HCI Read Link Quality and link role logged once per second
method.metrics: dropped audio = RTP timestamp advance beyond the previous packet's duration (LDAC frames x 256 / 96 kHz); missing RTP = sequence gaps

spots.A: near, then a moderate indoor distance; the official configuration already dropped audio near the source
spots.B: about 12 m straight line through a melamine interior door, an aluminium exterior door and the tester's body; with the official configuration dropouts started before reaching the first door

method.limits: one V3 Blaze unit, one source phone, indoor residential environment; spot B runs vary with body/phone position, so differences of about 10 s between B runs are within run-to-run variation. Captures contain Bluetooth addresses and audio and are not published.

runs.configuration: official main.conf + bluetoothd role patch (diagnostic only)

runs.note: capture includes a reconnection that started at 330/660 kb/s before the source was set back to 990
source in LDAC adaptive mode (Android reset after reconnection); walked away until dropouts began

runs.configuration: v1.2.0 main.conf + controller sleep mode disabled (HCI 0xfc27 all zero)
v1.2.0 main.conf + AzureWave HCD 0122.0538 instead of AP6212A1 1010.1030

conclusions: Official configuration: the source sustained only about 400 kb/s even at link quality 255 and discarded about 60 % of the audio; no RTP packets were lost on the air.
Disabling LE (ControllerMode = bredr) and fast connectable page scan restores sustained 990 kb/s with no dropped audio at spot A.
The bluetoothd role patch alone does not help (57 % dropped) and adds nothing on top of the main.conf change at spot B.
Disabling controller sleep mode and swapping to the AzureWave HCD produced no improvement beyond run-to-run variation at spot B; neither is shipped.
Remaining dropouts at spot B occur at link quality below about 60 and are attributed to the physical link limit.
